summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) of CipherBox — 7 plans implementing SDK pinning abstractions, API CID registration, Settings UI, TEE-based pin migration, and benchmarks — then plan gap closure for issues found during UAT.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed and committed; 6 bugs found and fixed during live Playwright UAT including a critical TEE env var mismatch and hex/base64 encoding bug in ECIES decryption; migration pipeline verified end-to-end (44/44 CIDs transferred, ~14s for 100MB); 4 gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) created for dual-pin upload wiring, TEE-routed connection test, PinataProvider, and benchmarks.

repo: TEE worker does not load .env files automatically — env vars must be passed inline (e.g. `VAR=val tsx src/index.ts`) or exported before invocation
Auth store is memory-only — no localStorage or sessionStorage persistence, so browser session is lost on page reload and requires fresh OTP login
E2E tests use EIP-6963 mock wallet (wallet-login-helpers.ts) as the primary auth path; email OTP LoginPage methods exist but no spec currently exercises them
OTP codes from the API are logged to task output files at /private/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/*.output — readable without terminal access
pnpm hot-reload does not always take effect if a prior API process still holds port 3000 — requires explicit kill + restart
Migration processor (BullMQ) picks up stale Redis jobs from previous failed runs on restart — can process old failed jobs before new ones trigger
SSRF protection in tee-worker blocks 192.168.* range by default, preventing local Kubo node testing in dev

code.finding: Used TEE_AUTH_SECRET env var but the rest of the codebase uses TEE_WORKER_SECRET — caused silent 500 errors on all migration attempts until fixed
ECIES-encrypted configs were hex-encoded by StorageTab (bytesToHex) but TEE worker decoded as base64 (Buffer.from(x, 'base64')) — caused 'bad point: got length 65' crash on every migration

providerChanged check required savedConfig to be non-null, but first-time users switching from default 'cipherbox' have no saved IPNS record — migration never triggered; fixed by treating null savedConfig as implicit cipherbox mode

Any non-200 response was treated as 'not this protocol' and fell through — 401/403/422 from real endpoints showed as 'could not detect protocol' instead of 'authentication failed'; fixed by detecting auth error status codes explicitly
parseProviderConfig only handled 'psa' | 'kubo' protocol types — 'cipherbox' source protocol caused a type error; required adding a cipherbox handler that fetches from the CipherBox IPFS gateway URL

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution works well for independent plans — waves 1 and 3 ran 2 plans simultaneously without conflicts
Playwright MCP + task output file reading is an effective combo for UI UAT without needing terminal access to the running dev server
DHCP IP changes on a QEMU VM host break all service connections — worth pinning the host IP or using DNS in docker-compose for resilience

SaaS IPFS providers (Pinata, Filebase) have diverged from standard PSA/Kubo RPC specs — Pinata deprecated /psa entirely, Filebase's CORS headers block browser-origin requests; self-hosted Kubo is the only reliably testable option from a browser

friction: Host IP changed from 192.168.133.114 to 192.168.133.12 after Docker stack recreation (DHCP), breaking all connections to PostgreSQL, Redis, and IPFS — required manual .env update across 5 references
TEE worker does not load .env, requiring a kill-and-restart with inline env vars to pick up TEE_WORKER_SECRET — not obvious from the codebase
API hot-reload silently failed multiple times due to EADDRINUSE (old process still holding port 3000) — needed explicit process kill to take effect
Pinata PSA endpoint (/psa) returns 404 — deprecated and undocumented; only discovered during live testing
Filebase IPFS RPC returned HTML error page for /api/v0/id — non-standard behavior not detectable until manual curl testing
Browser CORS blocked all SaaS IPFS provider connection tests — the connection test UI works only for self-hosted Kubo nodes with CORS configured
Old failed migrations persist in DB and show as 'migrating 0/38' in UI — no retry/dismiss mechanism, required switching modes twice to trigger a fresh migration
Playwright session lost on every API restart requiring fresh OTP login — slowed iterative debugging significantly
pnpm dev process killed when user ran `cd ..` — lost running server state mid-debugging
open_items: Plan 21-08: Dual-pin upload wiring — DualPinProvider exists in SDK but web upload flow does not invoke secondary pin; files land only on CipherBox node in dual-pin mode
Plan 21-08: Source unpin after migration — migration is copy-only with no cleanup; source provider retains all pins after migration completes
Plan 21-09: TEE-routed connection test — move connection testing from browser-side (CORS-blocked) to TEE worker (in-enclave decrypt + probe), matching zero-knowledge architecture
Plan 21-10: PinataProvider — native Pinata v3 API (/v3/files) implementation; current PSA/Kubo providers cannot connect to Pinata
Plan 21-11: BYO benchmark baselines — 21-byo-baselines.md deferred; load test scenarios are written and ready, need real provider infrastructure to execute
1 CID failed during reverse migration (44/45) — likely a CID v0/v1 format mismatch between Kubo nodes; root cause not investigated
SSRF simulator bypass (disabled for dev mode) should be removed or gated behind NODE_ENV=development before production deployment of TEE worker
